# MOTTO Automotive

> MOTTO Automotive is a UAE manufacturer of dealer-branded number plate holders and automotive accessories. The company supports automotive dealers, fleets and mobility partners with in-house development, production, finishing, inspection and packaging.

## Core products

- [Number plate holders](https://motto.ae/products/number-plate-holders): Custom dealer-branded accessory frames developed around confirmed UAE plate formats and vehicle applications.
- [3D emblems and badges](https://motto.ae/products/3d-automotive-badges): Custom dimensional automotive branding with application-specific finishes and attachment systems.
- [Branded keychains](https://motto.ae/products/dealer-keychains): Dealer handover keychains, hardware and presentation packaging.
- [Custom sunshades](https://motto.ae/products/custom-car-sunshades): Branded windscreen sunshades for dealer, fleet and campaign programmes.
- [Showroom plates](https://motto.ae/products/showroom-plates): Non-registration display plates for showrooms, launches, photography and events.
- [White-label automotive accessories](https://motto.ae/products/white-label-automotive-accessories): Coordinated product development, sampling, manufacturing, inspection, packaging and recurring supply under the customer's approved brand.
- [All product categories](https://motto.ae/products/): Index of MOTTO Automotive product landing pages.

## Important legal distinction

MOTTO Automotive manufactures accessory number plate holders and non-registration display products. It does not issue or reproduce official UAE registration plates. Official plates are issued through competent licensing authorities. Holders must not cover, obscure, distort, alter or reduce the readability of official plate data. See [Federal Decree-Law No. 14 of 2024 On Traffic Regulation](https://uaelegislation.gov.ae/en/legislations/2598) and confirm current requirements with the relevant emirate authority.
